thread:
Maya: Heads-up — ran into a weird perf regression on L4 when we enabled the new kv-prefetch + small-batch heuristic. Latency p50 jumps ~35% for chat workloads with avg seqlen 64.
Alex: Ugh. Can you paste the repro or a quick trace?
Maya: Repro is a local load test hitting convo workloads (avg 3 reqs/s, 4 concurrent). Quick profile attached below.
Maya: ```
CONFIG:
  kernel_preset: hetero-evict-friendly
  batching.min_batch: 2
  batching.max_batch: 8
  kv.cache_policy: prefetch-on-prefix
  kv.bucket_size: 32
```
Maya: On H100 this config is fine. On L4 we see lots of small kernel launches + frequent KV eviction churn.
Liam: Do you have the timeline of KV hits vs evictions?
Maya: Yes — paste from perf-bot: 
perf-bot: [1768899999] KV_HITS=48% KV_EVICTIONS/sec=13.2 GPU_KERNEL_LAUNCHES/sec=210
perf-bot: [1768900050] KV_HITS=21% KV_EVICTIONS/sec=57.8 GPU_KERNEL_LAUNCHES/sec=420
Alex: That eviction spike lines up with the p50 jump. Looks like L4's smaller SRAM + different memory allocator causes the prefetch to thrash.
Jen: Did the autotuner pick a different kernel on L4? Maybe a lower-memory kernel that doesn't cooperate with our KV layout.
Maya: Autotuner chose small-batch-friendly fused attention for L4 (to hit latency targets). But that kernel uses a different KV packing layout which increases per-request KV footprint ~1.8x.
Liam: That explains eviction. So sequence length distribution matters: short sequences trigger fused kernel that inflates KV working set.
Alex: Proposed mitigation: add a device-aware preset that prefers the non-fused kernel when kv.cache_policy=prefix-prefetch and bucket_size < 64. Example heuristic: 
```
if device.family in ["L4","T4"] and kv.bucket_size < 64:
  prefer_kernels = ["standard_kv_path"]
  max_batch = min(max_batch, 4)
```
Jen: Also consider decreasing prefetch aggressiveness on small-memory GPUs: reduce prefetch depth from 4 -> 1. That should cut eviction pressure.
Maya: Quick numbers after toggling prefetch depth to 1 in local repro: p50 drop back to baseline (-8% vs H100), KV_EVICTIONS/sec down to 9.4.
perf-bot: [1768900150] REPRO_RUN: p50=87ms p95=310ms KV_HITS=44% KV_EVICTIONS=9.4
Liam: Sounds promising. We should capture this in a new tuning preset: "small-mem-kv-safety". Include tests in autotune matrix: seqlen {8,64,512}, batch {1..8}, device family {L4,T4,A10}.
Alex: Agreed. Also add a check in kernel-selector to account for estimated kv footprint: prefer kernel K1 if est_kv_size(kernel) * expected_concurrency > device.kv_capacity * 0.8 -> avoid K1.
Maya: I'll draft the preset + perf test and push a canary. Plan: 1) add preset, 2) run cross-device smoke on CI, 3) monitor KV_EVICTIONS and p50.
Jen: Leave a note to update the console's per-route KPIs to include KV_EVICTIONS — currently hidden. Will help QA.
Maya: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Alex: If you want I can pair on the autotune rule later today.
Maya: Yes please, ping me after stand.
